title: Parrot
card: An African Grey on a low perch sees through two eyes on the sides of its head. Place things round it and watch what it sees.
tagline: Two eyes, a wide view, and things you place round the perch
kicker: A BODY AND TWO EYES FOR A BRAIN
feature: A parrot with two eyes on the sides of its head: each sees 175 degrees, they overlap a little in front, and behind is a blind spot. Its brain receives both images ten times a second and moves its head, beak, wings and feet.
howTo: Drag a thing nearer or further and watch the distance neurons answer, or silence them. Add things, move one behind the parrot, run the test, or move the joints yourself. Point at a ? to see what a part does.
